title: BigP3BCI Study L — 6x6 multi-paradigm (11 ALS subjects)
description: EEG recordings from 11 participants with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) performing a P300-based brain-computer interface speller task on a 6x6 character grid with multiple stimulus paradigms. The data are Study L of the larger bigP3BCI collection (about 267 subjects across 20 studies). They are provided as a BIDS derivative with HED event annotations, with target and non-target flash events labeled for P300 detection.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp (g.tec) amplifier from 16 channels at 256 Hz, using a standard 10-20 montage. The line frequency was 60 Hz. Participants used a visual P300 speller with online feedback in a laboratory. Each participant completed one session with a calibration-then-test design. Events are Target and NonTarget flashes.
